message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep regenerated for the products in Products.txt, covering the last 24 hours before the rerun at 2026-06-24 15:11 IST. Fresh, relevant activity remains concentrated around OpenSSH and ManageEngine. A PostgreSQL package advisory is included as a relevant advisory update because it was issued on 2026-06-23, but the underlying PostgreSQL CVEs were disclosed earlier. Google also posted a Chrome for Android release on 2026-06-23 that inherits Chrome desktop security fixes from the corresponding build; those CVEs were originally disclosed earlier, so it is noted but not counted as a brand-new vulnerability disclosure.

**Finding 1**

- Product: OpenSSH
- Issue: CVE-2026-55655
- Severity: Medium, CVSS 5.0, per Red Hat CNA data in NVD
- Description: A local unprivileged attacker on a Linux client host may hijack client-side X11 forwarding connections when X11 forwarding is enabled and a local UNIX-domain X socket is used. This can expose forwarded X11 traffic, including window contents and input, and may allow limited manipulation of the forwarded session.
- Relevance: OpenSSH is in the monitored product list. NVD received the CVE from Red Hat on 2026-06-23 and shows CISA-ADP activity on 2026-06-23 within the current monitoring window.
- Source: NVD CVE-2026-55655: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-55655

**Finding 2**

- Product: OpenSSH
- Issue: CVE-2026-55653
- Severity: Medium, CVSS 4.3, per Red Hat CNA data in NVD
- Description: A malicious SSH server may trigger a double-free condition in the Diffie-Hellman Group Exchange client path when the OpenSSH client processes attacker-controlled DH-GEX group parameters in FIPS mode, causing client-side denial of service.
- Relevance: OpenSSH is in the monitored product list. NVD received the CVE from Red Hat on 2026-06-23 and shows CISA-ADP activity on 2026-06-23 within the current monitoring window.
- Source: NVD CVE-2026-55653: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-55653

**Finding 3**

- Product: ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus, RecoveryManager Plus, M365 Manager Plus, and ADAudit Plus
- Issue: CVE-2026-11374
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.0, per ManageEngine CNA data in NVD; ManageEngine advisory labels it High
- Description: Predictable SSO tickets could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over accounts in affected ManageEngine products.
- Relevance: ManageEngine is in the monitored product list. NVD records the CVE as published on 2026-06-23 and last modified on 2026-06-24, which is within the current monitoring window.
- Sources: ManageEngine advisory: https://www.manageengine.com/products/self-service-password/advisory/CVE-2026-11374.html; NVD CVE-2026-11374: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-11374

**Relevant advisory update**

- Product: PostgreSQL 16 packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8
- Issue: RHSA-2026:28143 covering CVE-2026-6478 and CVE-2026-6473
- Severity: Important, per Red Hat advisory
- Description: Red Hat issued a PostgreSQL 16 security update on 2026-06-23 for a credential-recovery timing channel in MD5 password comparison and an integer-overflow/out-of-bounds write issue.
- Relevance: PostgreSQL is in the monitored product list. This is a fresh package advisory, but the underlying PostgreSQL CVEs were previously disclosed, so it is not treated as a brand-new vulnerability disclosure.
- Source: Red Hat RHSA-2026:28143: https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHSA-2026%3A28143

**Relevant browser update note**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: Chrome for Android 149.0.7827.197 release referencing the corresponding desktop security fixes
- Severity: The corresponding Chrome desktop security update included Critical and High Chromium security issues; the June 23 Android post itself does not list new CVEs.
- Description: Google released Chrome 149.0.7827.197 for Android on 2026-06-23 and states Android releases contain the same security fixes as their corresponding desktop releases unless otherwise noted.
- Relevance: Google Chrome is in the monitored product list. This is relevant for Chrome on Android deployments, but it is not counted as a newly disclosed CVE set because the underlying security fixes were disclosed in the earlier desktop advisory.
- Source: Chrome Releases, 2026 archive: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/

**Possible matches needing review**

- Product or component: WordPress plugin Simple Basic Contact Form
- Issue: CVE-2026-8172
- Severity: High, CVSS 7.1 from CISA-ADP scoring in NVD
- Description: The Simple Basic Contact Form plugin for WordPress has a reflected cross-site scripting issue affecting versions through 20250114.
- Why review is needed: WordPress is monitored, but this is a plugin-specific finding and the plugin is not one of the named monitored plugins. Include only if this plugin is present in the environment.
- Source: NVD CVE-2026-8172: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-8172

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for ManageEngine deployments because the reported impact is account takeover and the CNA score is Critical. OpenSSH items appear medium severity and context dependent, but should be reviewed where X11 forwarding or FIPS-mode DH-GEX client paths are used.
